title: ExoProbe telescope network to find and recover an ET probe

tellings.quote: pick up the object and bring it down to the earth because that's what I would like to do to bring down an actual ET probe. So that's what exoprobe is about.

plain: An astronomer, Beatriz Villarroel, describes a project she calls ExoProbe, a network of telescopes in New Mexico. She says the aim is to find an object sent by beings from another world and then pick it up and bring it down to Earth. If it worked, it would mean holding a real alien probe in human hands.
